name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year directly to bank account
benefit_hindi: हर साल 6,000 रुपये सीधे बैंक खाते में
plain_language_summary: Farmer gets 6000 rupees every year from government in three installments of 2000 each directly to bank account. Any farmer who owns land qualifies.
apply_url: https://pmkisan.gov.in

name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin
benefit: Rs 1.2 lakh for house construction (Rs 1.3 lakh in hilly areas)
benefit_hindi: मकान बनाने के लिए 1,20,000 रुपये
plain_language_summary: Poor rural families who do not have a pucca house get money from government to build one. BPL families, SC/ST, women-headed households get priority.
apply_url: https://pmayg.nic.in

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
benefit: Rs 15,000 toolkit + skill training + Rs 1 lakh loan at 5% interest
benefit_hindi: 15,000 रुपये का टूलकिट + 5% ब्याज पर 1 लाख रुपये का लोन
plain_language_summary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople like carpenter, blacksmith, weaver, tailor, cobbler, barber, potter get free toolkit worth 15000 rupees and training and cheap loan.
apply_url: https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
name_hindi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
benefit: Rs 300-2500 per month (varies by state)
benefit_hindi: हर महीने 300 से 2,500 रुपये (राज्य के अनुसार)
plain_language_summary: Widow woman aged 40 to 79 from BPL family gets monthly pension from government. Amount varies by state but is typically 1500 to 2500 rupees per month when state adds top-up.
apply_url: Apply at gram panchayat or block development office

name: Indira Gandhi Old Age Pension
benefit: Rs 200-3000 per month (centre + state top-up)
benefit_hindi: हर महीने 200 से 3,000 रुपये (राज्य के अनुसार)
plain_language_summary: Senior citizens aged 60 and above from BPL families get monthly pension. Central government gives 200 to 500 rupees and state government adds more making it 1000 to 3000 rupees in most states.
apply_url: Apply at gram panchayat or block development office

name: National Scholarship Portal Scholarships
benefit: Rs 10,000 to Rs 75,000 per year depending on course
benefit_hindi: हर साल 10,000 से 75,000 रुपये छात्रवृत्ति
plain_language_summary: Students from families with income below 2.5 lakh per year get scholarship for their studies. SC ST OBC students get priority but general category students also qualify.
apply_url: https://scholarships.gov.in

name: PM Mudra Yojana
benefit: Loan up to Rs 50,000 (Shishu) or Rs 5 lakh (Kishor) without collateral
benefit_hindi: बिना गारंटी 50,000 से 5 लाख रुपये का लोन
plain_language_summary: Small business owners, street vendors, shopkeepers, artisans can get a loan without any collateral or guarantee. Up to 50000 for new businesses and up to 5 lakh for existing ones.
apply_url: https://udyamimitra.in or any bank

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
name_hindi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
benefit: Rs 5 lakh health insurance per family per year
benefit_hindi: परिवार को हर साल 5 लाख रुपये तक का मुफ्त इलाज
plain_language_summary: BPL families get free health insurance of 5 lakh rupees per year for hospital treatment. No premium to pay. Check eligibility on website with Aadhaar number.

eligibility.income: BPL families as per SECC 2011 database

apply_url: https://pmjay.gov.in — check eligibility first

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
benefit: 5 kg free grain per person per month
benefit_hindi: हर व्यक्ति को हर महीने 5 किलो मुफ्त अनाज
plain_language_summary: Poor families with ration card get 5 kg of wheat or rice per person per month completely free. If you have a ration card you may already be getting this.
apply_url: Available at local ration shop — apply for ration card at state food department

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Credit up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% interest for farming expenses
benefit_hindi: खेती के खर्च के लिए 4% ब्याज पर 3 लाख रुपये तक का क्रेडिट
plain_language_summary: Farmers can get a credit card from bank to pay for seeds, fertiliser, pesticides. Interest rate is only 4 percent which is much lower than normal loans. Even tenant farmers can apply.
apply_url: Apply at any bank or cooperative bank near you

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: 8.2% interest rate savings scheme for girl child education/marriage
benefit_hindi: बेटी के लिए 8.2% ब्याज दर पर बचत योजना
plain_language_summary: Parents can open a savings account for their daughter below age 10 and get 8.2 percent interest which is much higher than bank FD. Money can be used for daughter's education and marriage.
apply_url: Open at any post office or bank

name: Startup India Seed Fund
benefit: Up to Rs 20 lakh grant + Rs 50 lakh soft loan for early-stage startups
benefit_hindi: स्टार्टअप के लिए 20 लाख तक का अनुदान और 50 लाख का नरम ऋण
plain_language_summary: Early stage startups recognized by DPIIT can get grant of up to 20 lakh rupees and soft loan of up to 50 lakh. Must have innovative product or service idea.
apply_url: https://seedfund.startupindia.gov.in

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
name_hindi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefit: Rs 30,000 to Rs 78,000 subsidy for rooftop solar + 300 units free electricity per month
benefit_hindi: सोलर पैनल लगवाने पर 78,000 रुपये तक की सब्सिडी + 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली
plain_language_summary: Households can get subsidy to install solar panels on roof and get 300 units of free electricity every month. This saves 1500 to 2000 rupees on electricity bill every month.
apply_url: https://pmsuryaghar.gov.in

name: NPS Vatsalya
benefit: Pension account for minors with tax benefits, converts to regular NPS at 18
benefit_hindi: बच्चों के लिए पेंशन खाता जो 18 साल पर NPS में बदल जाता है
plain_language_summary: Parents can open a pension savings account for their children. Money invested now grows with market returns and gives large retirement corpus. Tax savings also available.
apply_url: Open at any bank or post office

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana
benefit: Zero balance bank account + Rs 10,000 overdraft + Rs 2 lakh accident insurance + Rs 30,000 life insurance
benefit_hindi: जीरो बैलेंस खाता + 10,000 ओवरड्राफ्ट + 2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा
plain_language_summary: Anyone can open a bank account without minimum balance. Also get 10000 rupees overdraft facility and 2 lakh rupees accident insurance and 30000 rupees life insurance all free.
apply_url: Walk into any bank with Aadhaar card

name: e-Shram Card Scheme
benefit: Rs 2 lakh accident insurance + access to all welfare schemes + priority in government jobs
benefit_hindi: 2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा + सभी कल्याण योजनाओं तक पहुंच
plain_language_summary: Unorganised sector workers like daily wage labourers, construction workers, domestic workers, street vendors register and get 2 lakh accident insurance and access to all government welfare schemes.
apply_url: https://eshram.gov.in or nearest CSC center

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
name_hindi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना
benefit: Free skill training + placement assistance + Rs 1,000 per month stipend during training
benefit_hindi: मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण + नौकरी + 1,000 रुपये प्रति माह वजीफा
plain_language_summary: Young people from rural areas aged 15 to 35 get free skill training in industries like IT, hospitality, healthcare, construction. Also get job placement help and monthly stipend during training.

eligibility.priority: SC/ST, minorities, women, PwD, BPL families

apply_url: https://ddugky.gov.in or local block office

name: Mahila Udyam Nidhi Scheme
benefit: Soft loan up to Rs 10 lakh at low interest for women entrepreneurs
benefit_hindi: महिला उद्यमियों के लिए 10 लाख तक का नरम ऋण
plain_language_summary: Women who want to start or expand their small business can get a soft loan of up to 10 lakh rupees at lower interest rate than banks. For beauty salon, tailoring, food business, any small enterprise.
apply_url: Apply at SIDBI or any nationalised bank

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Crop insurance — up to Rs 2 lakh compensation if crop fails due to weather/pest
benefit_hindi: फसल खराब होने पर 2 लाख रुपये तक का मुआवजा
plain_language_summary: Farmers pay very low premium and get insurance for their crops. If crops fail due to flood, drought, cyclone, pest attack, government pays compensation up to 2 lakh rupees.
apply_url: Apply at bank or CSC before crop sowing deadline

name: MGNREGA Job Card
benefit: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per year at minimum wages (Rs 267-357/day by state)
benefit_hindi: साल में 100 दिन काम की गारंटी, न्यूनतम मजदूरी पर
plain_language_summary: Rural adult can demand 100 days of work from gram panchayat every year. If work not given within 15 days, unemployment allowance is paid. Work is always within 5 km of home.
apply_url: Apply at gram panchayat — everyone in rural India has the right
